## Positions {#positions}

::: position
> "The most oppressed man can oppress one being, his wife. She is the
> proletarian of the proletarian himself."
>
> [— after Flora Tristan, *L'Union ouvrière*, 1843]{.attrib}

I stand, in no order and no hierarchy, with those who are oppressed: the
victims of racism and antisemitism; women, against sexism; workers, against
the bourgeois who live off their exploitation; lesbian, gay, bisexual and
transgender people; disabled people; and all peoples subjected to war,
ethnic cleansing, apartheid or genocide (the Palestinian, Sudanese and
Uyghur peoples, and all the others I have no room to name).
:::

::: position
> "Ecology without class struggle is just gardening."
>
> [— attributed to Chico Mendes]{.attrib}

I do not claim to save the environment through my research, still less "the
planet" — which will do quite well, with or without us. Nor do I believe
that accumulating knowledge is what will change things: understanding a
world better is not enough to protect it
([Dupont et al., 2025](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41559-024-02535-0)). If I
do this work, it is out of curiosity — the wish to understand how nature
organises itself around us — and not to turn it into a political lever. For
to defend the living world we inhabit, I believe only one thing truly acts:
political engagement and collective struggle.
:::
